decorated_polytope_class.definition: the nine pinned complete mixed-reflection chambers of even 2-elementary lattices (r,a,delta) with r+a=22, equipped with the canonical Coble quotient norm dictionary: long (-4), divisibility-two facets are required to descend from (-2)-curves
decorated_polytope_class.short_wall_warning: short square-minus-two walls encode boundary halves or downstairs square-minus-one curves; stable/tangent alternatives are not put through the forced split-root test

necessary_criterion.formula: for n_ij=(v_i.v_j)/2 and a_ij,b_ij>=0 with a_ij+b_ij=n_ij, H_ii=2 and H_ij=n_ij-2a_ij must be positive semidefinite
necessary_criterion.saturated_radical_condition: for every integral z in ker(H), sum z_i v_i must lie in 2M

raw_source.input_fields: only the nine complete wall Gram matrices with r+a=22; no Coble type labels or surface curve lists
raw_source.paper: Valery Alexeev, Reflective hyperbolic 2-elementary lattices, K3 surfaces and hyperkahler manifolds, arXiv:2209.09110v4

scope.proved: a non-tautological necessary carrier criterion and exact no-go/host consequences on an independently defined nine-element raw-P class
scope.type_I_II_noncontradiction: the complex Type-I/II Coble nef chambers are different subgroup/full-nef wall systems (for example H10/22 and H10/30), not Alexeev's complete 12-wall mixed-reflection chamber for (11,11,1)

theorems.class_wide_complex_no_go: none of the nine complete mixed-reflection chambers can be the exact full nef chamber of a complex strong-Coble quotient under the stated norm decoration
theorems.five_absolute_numerical_no_gos: the rows (11,11,1), (12,10,1), (13,9,1), (14,8,0), and (14,8,1) admit no nonnegative split-intersection Gram at all
theorems.rank16_all_characteristic_no_go: the (16,6,1) split lattice has rank 22 and determinant 12; every finite-index even rank-22 overclosure has determinant 12 or 3, neither the p^(2 sigma) determinant of a supersingular K3
theorems.type_MII_host_forced: the (18,4,0) split lattice is rank 22, even, signature (1,21), and determinant 9; its only possible proper even overclosure would be even unimodular of signature (1,21), impossible modulo 8.  Thus any K3 carrier is supersingular in characteristic 3 with Artin invariant 1
theorems.type_VI_calibration: the (15,7,1) split differences span E6(-2) of rank 6, so the generated algebraic lattice has rank 21; a carrier cannot be complex and needs at least one additional positive-characteristic Picard class
